title: The Homecoming of Lake Minnow
author: L. M. Eriksen
blurb: Astrid Dravenmoor, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
